diagram_math_checks.evidence: Original Definition lines 46–55 defines D_psi M=HOM_k(M,k)^psi for finite graded modules and P#=HOM_B(P,B)^psi for finite graded projectives. The new two rows repeat precisely these assignments and label their domains separately. Every arrow is a mapsto object assignment, explicitly not a module map; no functor covariance or additional commutative square is asserted.

Original Definition lines 39–43 chooses the descended generator-fixing anti-involution, not word reversal. def-the-klr-cartan-pairing identifies it as horizontal reflection and p.r=psi(r)p. Thus vector dual has (af)(m)=f(psi(a)m); Hom dual twists its right action to (ag)(p)=g(p)psi(a). The diagram uses exactly this psi on both rows and introduces neither a crossing convention nor a super sign.

The two terminal labels reproduce original Definition lines 49 and 54–55. For the top row finite-dimensional evaluation m -> (f -> f(m)) is B-linear because psi squared is the identity, homogeneous of degree zero and bijective. For the bottom row evaluation p -> (g -> psi(g(p))) is B-linear after the two twists; it is an isomorphism on finite shifted-free modules and their finite projective retracts. This is the finite shifted-free/retract interface in def-finitely-generated-graded-projective-module and supplier lem-cyclotomic-projective-covers-and-dualities-descend-through-the-quotient Proof 3.1. No double-Hom assertion is extended to arbitrary nonprojectives.

def-graded-ring-module-bimodule-and-internal-shift defines (M{r})_d=M_(d-r) and explicitly excludes super signs. A degree-t homogeneous Hom out of M{r} is degree t+r out of M, giving HOM(M{r},N)=HOM(M,N){-r}. This gives the two displayed shift identities, with no extra sign or Frobenius shift. The figure does not identify D_psi P with P#; its final caption retains the original comparison shift -2 def_Lambda(beta). The rank-one difference and all normalizations remain untouched.

This definition has no proof section. All original defining claims and supplier justifications remain byte-identical. New final prose explicitly states that the illustration is expository and the justifications remain independent of it.
